prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Cobalt (코발트) itself — the sovereign of the Cobalt Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a cute, bright-eyed sweetness; fair skin; diamond-shaped face; large eyes — wide almond eyes, outer eye corners slightly lifted; soft rounded brows; upturned nose; small bow lips; rose-pink eyes; dark berry lipstick.
Body and hair: petite and short in stature yet voluptuous — a very full, heavy bust, a narrow waist and generously rounded hips on a small, compact frame, with realistic thighs and legs build; a layered shag with face-framing pieces with side-swept bangs; deep cobalt-blue hair with a glassy smalt sheen.
Expression: a faint knowing smile.
Her element, carried in her design: cobalt: a hard, faintly bluish silver metal named for the kobold, the mischievous goblin of Saxon mines blamed for stealing silver and leaving behind ore that gave off poisonous arsenic fumes in the furnace; melted into glass it gives the deepest, most enduring blue, the blue of blue-and-white porcelain, of smalt and of cobalt-blue paint; its weathered ore blooms in rose-pink crystals, and its salts turn pink when wet and blue when dry; today the heart of rechargeable batteries and powerful magnets, and the core of vitamin B12; mischievous, crafty and gifted.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Deep cobalt-blue armor with porcelain-white panels painted in fine blue-and-white patterns, layered battery-cell plates at the back glowing charge-blue, ring magnets orbiting the wrists, small pointed goblin-ear sensor fins and a rose-pink crystal core; crafty, mischievous and gifted; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: sparse outer plates over an exposed mechanical skeleton of metal struts, pistons and cables — light and precise. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: deep cobalt blue, porcelain white, cobalt-bloom rose pink, bluish steel silver.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, a city that runs on stored lightning: towering battery stacks glowing deep cobalt blue, maglev trains gliding on rails of powerful cobalt magnets, crystal-lattice cathode walls shimmering like stacked blue tiles.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Co) and atomic number (27) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
